capabilities: Render forest code blocks as inline SVG trees
Draw movement arrows with TikZ-style out/in and bend control
Apply per-node options like roof, tier, and phantom
Customize tree appearance via settings and CSS selectors
extras: Explicitly states it is not a complete port of the forest LaTeX package, covering only the subset syntacticians use daily; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to draw linguistics syntax trees in the forest package notation that syntacticians use.

relations.evidence: The plugin processes the source as forest-package syntax

summary: Renders LaTeX forest-style syntactic trees inline from fenced code blocks, with MathJax-rendered labels and TikZ-style movement arrows as SVG.
